def sample_pearson_correlation(x, y):
    """
    Calculate sample Pearson correlation coefficient.
    Uses n-1 in the denominator (sample covariance and sample standard deviations).
    """
    n = len(x)
    mean_x = sum(x) / n
    mean_y = sum(y) / n
    
    # Sample covariance (dividing by n-1)
    covariance = sum((xi - mean_x) * (yi - mean_y) for xi, yi in zip(x, y)) / (n - 1)
    
    # Sample standard deviations (dividing by n-1)
    std_x = (sum((xi - mean_x) ** 2 for xi in x) / (n - 1)) ** 0.5
    std_y = (sum((yi - mean_y) ** 2 for yi in y) / (n - 1)) ** 0.5
    
    return covariance / (std_x * std_y)
